name: adder8_ripple
title: 8-bit ripple-carry adder with a per-cycle carry-wave trace
description: Adder8 chains eight FullAdders with a generator. Besides settled sums, the carry_wave trace pokes A=0xFF then Cin=1 and observes Sum/Cout after every single cycle while the carry ripples down the chain — the unit-delay fidelity centerpiece.
